@@U01020@@
to ring and the kettle to sound, making music. In conclusion she brings a large volume and arranges the MONKEYS in the circle to serve as a lectern and to hold the torches. She beckons 浮士德 to approach her.)

@@U01022@@
(To 梅菲斯特.)

@@U01023@@
What’s the meaning of this? What good will it do? I’ve seen this all before, the insane apparatus, the idiotic gestures, the nauseating absurdity of it all! It’s a fraud! I despise it! I despise it to my heart’s core!

@@U01025@@
Well, of course, it’s nonsense! Relax, it’s a joke, can’t you see that? She’s a doctor, after all; she needs the hocus-pocus to make it work.

@@U01026@@
(He forces 浮士德 into the circle.)

@@U01028@@
(After all the holes are bored and plugged.)

@@U01029@@
Hear me and see! Out of one make ten, Let two go, then Make an even three, And you'll be rich. Since four won't mix, Out of five and six, So says the witch, Make seven and eight. And then it’s straight. And nine is one, And ten is none, And there’s the witch’s One-times-one.

@@U01031@@
I suspect the old crone’s having a fit.
translation:
@@U01020@@
铃声响起，水壶发出声音，发出音乐。最后，她带来了一本大书，并将猴子排列在圆圈中，作为讲台并拿着火把。她示意浮士德靠近她。）

@@U01022@@
（对梅菲斯特。）

@@U01023@@
这有什么意义呢？会有什么好处呢？我以前见过这一切，疯狂的装置，愚蠢的手势，这一切令人作呕的荒谬！这是一个骗局！我鄙视它！我从心里鄙视它！

@@U01025@@
嗯，当然，这是废话！放松点，这是个笑话，你看不出来吗？毕竟她是一名医生；她需要一些诡计才能让它发挥作用。

@@U01026@@
（他强迫浮士德进入圈子。）

@@U01028@@
（所有孔都钻孔并堵塞后。）

@@U01029@@
听我说，看看吧！一分十，放掉二分，然后凑成三分，你就会变得富有。既然四个不能混合，五和六中，所以女巫说，七和八。然后就直了。九是一，十是无，还有女巫的一次性一。

@@U01031@@
我怀疑老太婆是抽搐了。
